record.title: Recover candidate RF source constraints and arrival checks
record.intent: Determine which source assumptions need documentation or physical qualification before measurement.
requirements: Research the candidate SG6000/MAX2870 source using official IC documentation, supplied board material and attributed third-party references. Keep IC capabilities, seller claims and verified board behavior distinct.
Assess fundamental range, reference clock, output level/control, harmonics/spurs, settling, connectors and power-on output behavior. Record unresolved details as explicit arrival checks.

Reassess the prior 10 MHz normalization anchor against the actual source range. Prefer a justified common-source reference; do not join an uncharacterized independent clock to an absolute amplitude curve.
Identify documentation-backed input/path constraints and verification needs. Do not operate hardware, modify the source, or develop an STM32 driver in this task.
acceptance: A sourced constraints note and arrival checklist identify what the candidate source can plausibly support and what remains unverified.
